title: The Reason I'm Taking You with Me / Gorgeous Tiger Reloaded
overview: Subaru sets out for the Pleiades Watchtower in hopes of saving his friends and the people of Priestella.

title: Overcome Sand Time
overview: Subaru and company struggle to cross the Auguria Dunes on the way to the Pleiades Watchtower.

title: The Keeper of the Watchtower
overview: The party is separated just before reaching the Pleiades Watchtower. Subaru awakens to find he's underground.

title: A White Sky Asterism
overview: Subaru and company meet Shaula, keeper of the Pleiades Watchtower, who leads them to the first of its trials.

title: Stick Swinger
overview: The Great Pleiades Library doesn't seem to have the answers Subaru seeks, so he decides they must go further.

title: Julius Juukulius
overview: Subaru and crew attempt to get past the second floor of the tower, but its examiner poses a tough challenge.

title: Walking Out of the Convenience Store and into a Wondrous World
overview: Julius overhears Anastasia and Subaru talking about Anastasia's current condition.

title: Who Are You?
overview: Subaru wakes up in the green room, remembering absolutely nothing about the world he is in.

title: Empty Shell
overview: Maddened by fear and distrust, Subaru attempts to escape the watchtower... only to end up lost underground.

title: Murder Is a Habit
overview: Shortly after Subaru discovers Meili's corpse, Beatrice finds a book with Meili's name on it in the archive.

title: Re: Life Starting in Another World From Zero
overview: Subaru tries desperately to convince the others that he's lost his memories, but they aren't convinced.

title: From Now On
overview: After waking up without his memories yet again, Subaru makes up his mind to save Meili this time.

title: Stand Up
overview: Subaru decides to read Reid's book of the dead in hopes of finding a way to defeat him.

title: Five Obstacles
overview: Subaru returns from the corridor of memories to find the tower under attack by mabeasts.

title: The Earnest Star
overview: Subaru searches for a way to deal with Reid, Gluttony, mabeasts, and a giant scorpion attacking the tower.

title: Natsuki Subaru
overview: With his mental state already in tatters, Subaru finds a book in the archive with his name on it.
